title: Data Entry Associate
description:
StrataBuilt is a forward\-thinking company dedicated to delivering high\-quality solutions of
 *custom software development and consulting* 
 .. We thrive on precision, efficiency, and teamwork. As we continue to grow, we are looking for detail\-oriented professionals to help us maintain data integrity and support operational excellence.
   

  

**Position Overview:**
 We are seeking a meticulous and dependable Data Entry Associate to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for accurately inputting, updating, and maintaining various types of information into our systems. Your work will be crucial in supporting our business operations and ensuring that our databases remain clean, current, and well\-organized.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
* Enter and update data in internal databases with high accuracy and attention to detail
* Verify data for completeness and correct errors
* Maintain data confidentiality and follow data protection guidelines
* Organize and maintain records, files, and documentation
* Collaborate with team members to ensure data consistency across departments
* Perform regular data audits to ensure data integrity
* Generate reports and assist with data analysis as needed


**Qualifications:**
* High school diploma or equivalent; associate degree preferred
* Proven experience in data entry or a similar administrative role
* Excellent typing skills and proficiency in MS Office (especially Excel)
* Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
* Ability to work independently and meet deadlines
* Familiarity with data management software and tools is a plus


**What We Offer:**
* Competitive salary and benefits
* Flexible work arrangements (on\-site, hybrid, or remote options available)
* Opportunities for career growth and development
* A supportive and collaborative work environment
